title: The Basalt Library
subtitle: An immersive apothecary experience inspired by silence and stone.
line: A library of scents carved from the volcanic heart of Jeju.
quote: Where the story ends, the ritual begins.
synopsis: You step into a space where the heavy, porous walls of black basalt evoke the scent of ancient paper and volcanic earth. At the center of this quiet chamber, you pause at the meditative ritual basin, where water and fragrance cleanse the senses. You then circle the room, exploring the shelves that house bottles like volumes in a library, before reaching the back counter. Here, amidst the lingering scent of damp stone, you conclude your journey.

why.d: Shelf walls (basalt shelf stacks) wrap the left, right and back of the 12 x 10 m room. The surrounding black basalt shelves create an atmosphere of scholarly seclusion and tactile permanence.

why.d: The centre object (meditative ritual basin) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. The central basin serves as a physical and sensory anchor, compelling you to pause and participate in a cleansing rite.

why.d: The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. The circular flow allows you to drift through the 'stacks' as if browsing a collection of literature.

why.d: The counter (minimal payment counter) sits at the back, off the loop. The placement of the payment counter ensures that the final interaction remains separate from the tranquil browsing experience.
